WITH victims AS (
            SELECT seq FROM outbox
            WHERE inserted_at < $1
              AND seq <= (
                  SELECT COALESCE(MIN(broadcast_watermark), 0)
                  FROM outbox_watermarks
                  WHERE updated_at > $2
              )
            ORDER BY seq
            LIMIT $3
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        DELETE FROM outbox WHERE seq IN (SELECT seq FROM victims)
        RETURNING seq
